name: Elturian Tails
source:
Beneath the stars of a well-earned victory celebration, you decide to indulge the evening with the infernal variety. Revel the evening away with your favorite tieflings and see where the night takes you.

This short Baldur's Gate 3 dating simulator reimagines the memorable night of the tiefling party at camp during Act I, just after saving the refugees from the goblins and Kagha.

[From [url=https://abogwitchnamedsage.itch.io/elturian-tails]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一场来之不易的胜利庆典的星光下，你决定尽情享受这个地狱般的夜晚。与你最喜欢的泰夫林一起度过夜晚，看看夜晚会带你去往何方。

这个简短的博德之门3约会模拟器重新想象了第一幕中蒂夫林营地派对的难忘夜晚，就在从妖精和卡加手中拯救难民之后。

[来自[url=https://abogwitchnamedsage.itch.io/elturian-tails]itch.io[/url]]
